title: In a joint filing, Elon Musk and the US SEC say they are ready to move toward a trial over Musk's alleged failure to disclose his Twitter stake in 2022 (Nicola M White/Bloomberg)
summary: Nicola M White / Bloomberg: In a joint filing, Elon Musk and the US SEC say they are ready to move toward a trial over Musk's alleged failure to disclose his Twitter stake in 2022 — Elon Musk and the US Securities Exchange Commission told a judge they are heading toward a trial over the regulator's allegations …
